title: Zuljanah Zuljanah hai kaha baba jaan
body:
Zuljanah, zuljanah..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Khali aaya hai shabbir ka zuljanah
<<MINI>>
Zuljanah, zuljanah
<<DIVIDER>>
zuljanah se sakina ne rokar kaha
1. Kyu hai baage kati, jism zakhmi tera
zeen khali hai kyu, aur sar hai jhuka
bolta kyu nahi, chup hai teri zabaa'n
<<MINI>>
zuljanah, zuljanah hai kaha'n baba jaa'n..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Tere payro'n se lipti mai kehti rahi
baad baba ke mai jee nahi paungi
mere baba ko tu, chhod aaya kaha'n
<<MINI>>
zuljanah, zuljanah hai kaha'n baba jaa'n..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Ab tamacho'n se mujhko bachayega kaun
mujhko seene pe apne sulayega kaun
is yatimi mein ab, kaun hai sayebaa'n
<<MINI>>
zuljanah, zuljanah hai kaha'n baba jaa'n..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Jis tarha mere saare sahare gaye
tu bata kya mere baba maare gaye kyu teri aankh se, hai ye aansu rawaa'n
<<MINI>>
zuljanah, zuljanah hai kaha'n baba jaa'n..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Kund khanjar chalane laga jab laee'n
mere baba ko paani diya kya nahi?
yaa dame zibha bhi, the wo tishna daha'n
<<MINI>>
zuljanah, zuljanah hai kaha'n baba jaa'n..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Mujhko batla gaye zakhm tere hai jo
itna zakhmi hai tu, kitne zakhmi the woh
teer kitne lage, kis qadar barchiya'n
<<MINI>>
zuljanah, zuljanah hai kaha'n baba jaa'n..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Dard furqat se dil mera phat jaega
apne baba ke seene pe chayn aayega
hai jaha'n babajaa'n, mujhko le chal waha'n
<<MINI>>
zuljanah, zuljanah hai kaha'n baba jaa'n..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Haye farhan o mazhar, sakina dukhi
zuljanah se lipat kar wo roti rahi
keh rahi thi ye masoom ki siskiya'n
<<MINI>>
zuljanah, zuljanah hai kaha'n baba jaa'n..(2)
Zuljanah, zuljanah..(4)
